title: SeaSalt Charters

services.name: Custom Charter
services.desc: Being that SeaSalt Charters offer private charter services, we ultimately want to leave it up to the customer what he or she would like to do in order to get the most out of their experience. Basically every trip at any time is a custom charter. However, if there is something specific you would like to plan out before booking your trip, just bring it up and we will work together to get you what you want. Imagine a whole day spent doing every sort of Cape Cod water activity thinkable. We can start the day looking for breaching Humpback Whales, maybe take a break for some nice lunch on the beach or anchor up in a calm location, the you may go snorkeling and search for Sea Clams.
